latest_release.name: v0.8.2: full MLX backend, rely on torch.compile, set python 3.9 as minimum
latest_release.body:
- torch.compile: previously we relied on registration of einops in torch.compile. This registration was called by torch. Now with torch >= 2.8 `torch.compile` engine can compile einops operations without additional hints/registrations.
- recommended backend for MLX is still `einops.array_api.<operation>`, but since community asked multiple times for support of `einops.einsum`, there is now MLX backend in einops, so `einops.<operation>` would also work with MLX.
- minor improvements to docs, and mention of several related projects.






## What's Changed
* Update README.md by @arogozhnikov in https://github.com/arogozhnikov/einops/pull/366
* Update codebase, introduce consistency checks, update EinMix tutorial by @arogozhnikov in https://github.com/arogozhnikov/einops/pull/374
* Update python versions in tests, change min supported version to 3.9 by @arogozhnikov in https://github.com/arogozhnikov/einops/pull/364
* mention cubed as one more backend via array api by @arogozhnikov in https://github.com/arogozhnikov/einops/pull/375
* Extend tests for torch.compile by @arogozhnikov in https://github.com/arogozhnikov/einops/pull/382
* add einops.jl and einops for R in docs_src/pages/projects.md by @Qile0317 in https://github.com/arogozhnikov/einops/pull/383
* mention ein color and AlphaFold3 by @arogozhnikov in https://github.com/arogozhnikov/einops/pull/389
* A bit more of compile tests by @arogozhnikov in https://github.com/arogozhnikov/einops/pull/390
* Patch #391 (conflicts in multithreading initialization) by @arogozhnikov in https://github.com/arogozhnikov/einops/pull/392
* switch off debug importing by @arogozhnikov in https://github.com/arogozhnikov/einops/pull/393
* Skip `allow_in_graph` if torch >= 2.8 by @guilhermeleobas in https://github.com/arogozhnikov/einops/pull/394
* Add mlx backend by @ifsheldon in https://github.com/arogozhnikov/einops/pull/376
* update testing by @arogozhnikov in https://github.com/arogozhnikov/einops/pull/395
